title: Stable-Use Credit on Tier Exception Approvals for Home Delivery Fills (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a stable-use credit is added to a tier exception approval for members who keep filling the drug by home delivery. The member's shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy orders of the drug are counted within the stable lookback of **12** months. An order is within the lookback when it lies fewer whole months than 12 before the decision date.

| Shipped home delivery orders of the drug within the lookback | Credit added |
|---|---|
| at least **3** (the stable fill count) | **3** months |
| 1 or 2 | **1** month |
| none | nothing |

Only shipped orders count. The credit is added to the tier approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

*Hypothetical counts.* Four shipped orders in the past year earn 3 months, and so do exactly three. Two earn 1 month. A member whose only shipped order is 12 whole months old earns nothing.
